attributes.name: avatar and thumbnail imagery type
attributes.definition: The kind of visual used to represent users or content items (avatars, thumbnails) on the page.

values.definition: Avatars are circles showing a letter initial instead of a photo.
Avatars or thumbnails are all photographs.
Thumbnails combine cartoons, clip-art, icons and/or stock photos in differing styles.
Initial-letter placeholders appear alongside photo avatars.

attributes.name: imagery style consistency
attributes.definition: Whether the images/avatars on a page share one coherent visual style or mix several.

values.definition: All images share a single style.
Images mix different styles or types without a unified treatment.
